edges: Chester Stiles is accused of raping the 2-year-old girl.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Elaine Thomas identified Chester Stiles as the suspect after seeing photos on the news.
The girl's mother expressed relief about Stiles' arrest.
Tina Allen believes she is the reason Stiles came in contact with the girl.
Judge Deborah Lippis set a preliminary hearing date for Chester Stiles.
